Rory Blake: FYI HelixCare asked for a 4-week POC to validate helix-30b-clin-adapt for discharge summaries + coding assistance. Their must-haves: private deployment option (AWS VPC), per-customer KMS/BYOK, ability to opt-out of request logs, and a pricing NTE for the trial. They also included a 39-question security questionnaire.
Amina Qureshi: Got it. Any details on typical input/output sizes and whether they stream?
Rory Blake: They reported avg input ~1.8k tokens, outputs ~300. They do chained notes occasionally up to ~9k and expect the POC to show good coherence across stitched contexts. Artifact is on HF under NDA: hf://helixcare/helix-30b-clin-adapt.
Devon Park: Ops note: 9k contexts -> need interleaved KV + chunking. For latency SLO (they asked for p95 ~350-450ms on 1.8k) recommend testing helix-30b-q4_k_m-kv and helix-14b-slim fallback. Also test int8-kv experimental for lower mem.
Nora Li: Security flag: they require SOC2 + DPA + a non-training clause for PHI. Need confirmation we can support BYOK flows into their KMS and produce a deletion certificate at trial end. I'll queue legal intake once questionnaire is attached.
perf-bot: Queued perf matrix POC-HX-004: run fp16, q4_k_m, int8-kv on seq-lens [2048, 4096, 9216] with batch=1. Results will post to ticket.
Amina Qureshi: SE checklist for quick validation: tokenizer diff, pos-encoding style (rotary vs rope), and probe hallucination/regression set. Snippet for SEs: 
```
redwoodctl model inspect --model hf://helixcare/helix-30b-clin-adapt
redwoodctl perf run --model helix-30b-clin-adapt --quant q4_k_m --kv interleaved --seq-len 9216 --batch 1
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json').encode('sample clinical note'))"
```
Devon Park: Note: this model family historically used RMSNorm + a custom gated activation. Triton path may fall back to slower kernels; include XLA runs in perf. Also test prefix caching effectiveness for repeated patient headers.
Rory Blake: For a fast path propose: (1) provision a 2x A100-80GB Dedicated pool behind a VPC peering for secure egress, (2) run perf jobs and share p50/p95 + token costs, (3) present three pricing options (hosted usage with HIPAA uplift, 4-week Dedicated reserved credits, Private install quote). Can we get perf + pricing sketch by EOD Wed?
Devon Park: I'll run perf today and post traces. If memory limits hit at 9k, we'll try kv-shard increase or fallback to a 14b-slim route for latency-critical endpoints.
Nora Li: Legal: I'll need the completed questionnaire and confirmation on BYOK/HSM support to open the DPA review. Also will request SOC2 evidence and subprocessor list.
Amina Qureshi: Routing plan suggestion: canary 5-10% to 30b-q4_k_m cluster, auto-fallback to 14b-slim for >450ms or health errors. Add per-request cost tagging for POC billing.
perf-bot: Ticket created: POC-HX-004 "HelixCare helix-30b-clin-adapt POC - BYOK, HIPAA, perf". Assigned: eng-runtime, sales-eng, legal. Link: <internal/POC-HX-004>.
Rory Blake: I'll send HelixCare the questionnaire and schedule kickoff for Tue 9am PT. SE/ops/legal please have perf, tokenizer diff, and a draft pricing NTE before the call.
Devon Park: Will post perf logs + short summary to the ticket by EOD.
Nora Li: I'll start legal intake once questionnaire is back. Also check BYOK on Private + Dedicated and confirm logging toggle options.
Rory Blake: Thanks team :thumbsup: adding HelixCare contacts and calendar invite.
